monitoring.linezolid: WHO: visual acuity and colour vision every 2 weeks for the first month after starting a linezolid-containing regimen, then monthly.

safety_rules: New loss of colour discrimination or visual acuity during ethambutol or linezolid therapy requires prompt clinical/ophthalmologic assessment.
Do not assume all blurred vision is medication toxicity; consider alternative ophthalmic and neurological causes.
Do not advise autonomous restart of a suspected offending drug.
Use current guideline to determine whether ethambutol/linezolid should be interrupted or removed.
